entries.title: Arrival.Space Plugins
entries.summary: Repository overview with quick start guidance, documentation links, supported property types, and the example plugin catalog.

entries.title: Agent Quickstart
entries.summary: High-signal checklist for generating Arrival.Space plugins, including shape, cleanup, property authoring, and example selection.

entries.title: Room Config — space/room.json schema (RoomInfo data)
entries.summary: Complete reference for the RoomInfo `data` fields of space/room.json — every setting in the Edit Space panel plus advanced keys: title, description, privacy, wall/floor/ceiling/glass colors and textures, skybox, lighting and shadows, post effects (framePosteffectParams: tone mapping, bloom, brightness/contrast), camera and movement, avatar overrides, collision, GPU texture downscaling / LOD quality (textureDivider, maxTextureSize), rendering backend (WebGPU, unifiedSplats), content folders, enterprise/branding, and discovery/SEO (enrichment, geo). Gives types, defaults, valid values, and which keys belong on entities instead of the room. Also documents SpawnPoint entities (where visitors appear / spawn): position, rotation (azimuth yaw + pitch), isDefaultThirdPerson, isDefaultFreeCam, alwaysSnapBack, hidden.

entries.title: API Reference
entries.summary: Reference for ArrivalScript lifecycle, ArrivalSpace helpers, model loading, UI, audio, physics, animation, avatars, and plugin management.

entries.title: ArrivalScript / ArrivalSpace API Reference (full, distilled)
entries.summary: Complete distilled API surface of the ArrivalScript base class and the ArrivalSpace runtime, generated from pluginUtils.js: lifecycle, ArrivalScript instance helpers, player & input, entities & geometry, materials, UI & panels, audio, events, camera, room & user, persistence (pluginStore/userData), and multiplayer (net + synced attribute()).

entries.title: Getting Started
entries.summary: Step-by-step introduction to creating a first plugin, adding properties, using the API, and understanding lifecycle hooks.

entries.title: Multiplayer API
entries.summary: Guide to synchronized state and messaging with attribute() and ArrivalSpace.net for real-time multiplayer plugins.

entries.title: Properties
entries.summary: Explains supported property types, static property schema, dynamic options, vec3 fields, file/asset upload fields (editor: 'asset'), restricting upload file types via the 'accept' extension list, growable array/list properties (array: true, entity and text rows), and runtime updates in the editor UI.

entries.title: Sequences & Cutscenes
entries.summary: Guide to keyframe animation with the sequencePlayer runtime — the same system referred to as sequences, cutscenes, or animations. Covers the entity-aware sequence shape, adapters/getters, markers and sequence:marker events, Catmull-Rom interpolation, authored cutscenes via getCutsceneScript, and playback attributes including reverse/loop/autoplay.

entries.title: Creating Cutscenes Headlessly (CLI / MCP) — .path files
entries.summary: How to author a cutscene/animation without the in-app Sequence Editor or a plugin: serialize a Sequence to a .path file, upload_text_file it, and create_entity from the resource_key. Covers the position/rotation(quat)/scale property keys, attaching the animation by target entity id in data.entities, auto-play/loop, and a worked recipe for spinning an image on one of its corners.

entries.title: Spin Image On Corner (.path cutscene)
entries.summary: A .path cutscene (not a plugin) that spins an image entity on one of its corners by driving position + rotation(quat) keyframes together. Target is attached via the entity id 'spin_image' key inside data.entities. See docs/cutscenes-via-mcp.md.

entries.title: Annotation Marker
entries.summary: 3D marker with an icon and markdown popup content rendered as an in-world panel.

entries.title: Avatar Animation
entries.summary: Overrides player idle, walk, and jump animations using custom GLBs and demonstrates animation speed control.

entries.title: Avatar Bone Attachment
entries.summary: Attaches a GLB model to a specific bone on the player's avatar skeleton with configurable bone selection, offset, rotation, and scale.

entries.title: Bouncy Box
entries.summary: Simple rotating and bouncing debug box used as a minimal behavior example.

entries.title: Box Stack
entries.summary: Builds a physics pyramid of boxes and spheres, showing rigidbody setup and tunable visual parameters.

entries.title: Character Scale
entries.summary: Adjusts the controlled character's scale and movement feel with an in-world draggable slider UI.

entries.title: Cloth Physics
entries.summary: Soft-body curtain example using Ammo.js cloth simulation, top-edge anchors, textured rendering, and nearby collider proxies.

entries.title: Dynamic Light
entries.summary: Reusable cone or point light controller with configurable light properties and optional helper visuals.

entries.title: First-Install Setup
entries.summary: Uses the onInstall(ctx) lifecycle hook to run a one-time setup panel right after a vibe is added in-app, writing the choices into the vibe's real editor parameters with setParams().

entries.title: Game HUD
entries.summary: Cinematic game-style HUD overlay that demonstrates app UI visibility, HTML overlays, and player-aware interface state.

entries.title: GLB Model
entries.summary: Loads and attaches an external GLB model as a child of the plugin entity.

entries.title: Google 3D Tiles
entries.summary: Streams Google Photorealistic 3D Tiles (the Google Earth dataset) as a full globe with distance-based LOD, re-centered on a configurable lat/lon so the chosen city builds up around the player; supports ground altitude tuning, detail factor, miniature-globe scaling, and camera far-clip override.

entries.title: Hello World
entries.summary: Smallest possible Arrival.Space plugin showing the basic script shape and lifecycle entry point.

entries.title: Hover Board
entries.summary: Rideable hover board with avatar animation hooks, player input handling, standing-object logic, and dynamic physics.

entries.title: Dynamic Iframe UI
entries.summary: Dynamic world-space information panel built with createHTMLPanel and iframe or CSS-driven content.

entries.title: Localized Light Probe
entries.summary: Spatial light probe volume with radius-based falloff that can override primary light direction/color, environment HDR, and post-effects as the player enters the volume.

entries.title: Firework Marker FX
entries.summary: Listens to a picked cutscene entity's timeline markers and spawns firework effects — ascent flames on launch/trail cues and a particle burst on the explode cue. Matches markers by explicit event name or by keyword in the marker label/id, and can hide a chosen rocket entity on detonation.

entries.title: NPC Character
entries.summary: Spawns an NPC that follows the local player — demonstrates createNPC, avatar setup, a click callback, and per-slot animations (Idle/Walk/Jump) driven by a catalog clip or a custom Mixamo .fbx upload that the platform auto-converts to a generic clip and retargets onto the avatar (VRM and modular/RPM).

entries.title: AI NPC
entries.summary: An LLM-driven character built on ArrivalSpace.ai.complete: click the NPC to open a chat panel; the plugin sends its persona (prePrompt) as the system prompt plus the running chat. Free GLM by default; the owner can add an OpenAI/Anthropic key (server-side, spent only through this entity). Shows createNPC + a chat UI + ai.complete continuation.

entries.title: AI Text Tool
entries.summary: A non-NPC example of ArrivalSpace.ai.complete: a HUD panel where the visitor pastes text, picks an operation (summarize / translate / rewrite), and the plugin builds its own system prompt and runs a one-shot completion (prompt only, no history). Demonstrates that ai.complete is general, plus the this.aiComplete() forwarder.

entries.title: Outfit Override
entries.summary: Temporarily overrides the player's avatar outfit parts and shows how to restore them on cleanup.

entries.title: Persistent Inventory
entries.summary: Cross-space collectible: drop on an entity, walk near to collect, and the record follows the user into every other space that uses the same inventoryId. Demonstrates per-user persistent storage (ArrivalSpace.userData), an inventory:pickup / inventory:change event bus, a shared top-right HUD with single-owner hand-off between instances, and a toggle-as-action reset pattern.

entries.title: Physics Box
entries.summary: Basic rigidbody and collision example for a simple physics-enabled object.

entries.title: Floating Cutscene Button
entries.summary: A floating 3D button built from PlayCanvas primitives that plays a selected cutscene entity when clicked. Demonstrates the entity picker (filterTypes: ['cutscene']), getCutsceneScript().playCutscene(), an editor action button, billboard facing, bob animation, click cooldown, max-distance check, and an error flash.

entries.title: PostProcessVolume
entries.summary: Local post-effects blend volume that smoothly overrides room post-processing as the player moves through space.

entries.title: Ragdoll Physics
entries.summary: Procedural avatar ragdoll: builds capsule rigid bodies and cone/hinge constraints from the player skeleton (RPM/Mixamo/VRM), auto-activates on velocity-delta impact with separate horizontal/vertical thresholds, transfers pre-impact velocity to bones, and tracks the head with the player capsule so the camera follows the fall.

entries.title: VRM Tuning & Debug
entries.summary: Live control panel + visualizer for the engine's native VRM systems (which run automatically for every loaded VRM). It does NOT simulate anything itself: spring-bone sliders (simulate spring bones, eye blink, ropiness/locomotion momentum, air resistance, stiffness/gravity/drag multipliers, extra drag, collision iterations) write straight into the global window.VRMSpringBones, and toon-material sliders (diffuse R/G/B, emissive, ambient, specular, shininess, reflectivity, glossiness, skybox, tonemap) write into window.VRMToonMaterial and call retuneAll() to re-shade every VRM material already in the scene. Debug Draw Colliders/Bones render the engine's actual solver state (read from VRMSpringBones._solvers) — the real world-space spheres, capsules and bone segments collision uses. Removing the plugin restores the globals to their pre-session values.

entries.title: Simple Chat
entries.summary: Multiplayer chat example using ArrivalSpace.net messages plus synced values for lightweight shared UI state.

entries.title: Snowfall Particle Plugin
entries.summary: Configurable snowfall effect built with the PlayCanvas particle system, tunable curves, wind, and custom texture support.

entries.title: Procedural Splats - Snow
entries.summary: Flattened GSplat snow cover that raycasts onto collision surfaces and builds soft packed snow clumps instead of round blobs.

entries.title: Scavenger Hunt
entries.summary: Controller plugin that discovers Scavenger Item entities via getPlugins and the plugin event bus, tracks proximity-based collection, and displays a progress HUD with a finish overlay.

entries.title: Scavenger Item
entries.summary: Gizmo-positionable collectible marker that announces itself via the plugin event bus. Supports a default box visual or custom GLB model with bob and rotate animation.

entries.title: Scene Tour Camera
entries.summary: Overlay panel listing every user-placed entity; clicking one switches to free cam and frames it via setFreeCamPose with AABB-based distance, optional smooth flight, and auto-orbit. Showcases getCameraMode/setCameraMode, getUIContainer, and userModelEntity discovery.

entries.title: Sound Trigger
entries.summary: Plays a sound when the player gets close to the object, demonstrating proximity-based audio behavior.

entries.title: Sound Press Button
entries.summary: Clickable 3D HTML button that plays, pauses, stops, or toggles a referenced Custom Sound entity via entity picker, with optional keyboard shortcut and editor action buttons.

entries.title: Scene Tour Camera
entries.summary: Overlay list of every user-placed entity; click an entry to switch to free cam and fly/frame it. Demonstrates getUIContainer, setFreeCamPose, setCameraMode/getCameraMode, lockInput/unlockInput, AABB-based framing, smooth fly-to, and optional auto-orbit cancelled by manual input.

entries.title: Procedural Splats - Fire
entries.summary: Animated GSplat fire effect with flame, smoke, and sparks driven by CPU-updated splat data.

entries.title: Procedural Splats - Fog
entries.summary: Box-shaped volumetric fog volume built from a uniform GSplat lattice with editable size, alpha, and overlap.

entries.title: Procedural Splats - Grass
entries.summary: Dense procedural grass field made from anisotropic GSplats, with blade height, width, lean, and spawn control.

entries.title: Lamp
entries.summary: Physical lamp with a GLB model, rigidbody collision, configurable point or cone light, shadows, splat lighting, and electric flicker effect.

entries.title: Vehicle Physics Model
entries.summary: Driveable Ammo.js vehicle with custom chassis and wheel GLBs, suspension, headlights, and desktop/mobile mount controls.

entries.title: Splat Shader
entries.summary: Loads a Gaussian Splat via loadSplat and applies custom GLSL vertex/fragment shaders with animated uniforms.

entries.title: Splat Reveal
entries.summary: Plays a configurable reveal animation on the space's already-loaded unified / LOD-streaming Gaussian splat by overriding the engine's gsplatCustomizeVS hook (modifyCenter / modifyCovariance / modifyColor). Patterns include radial wave, sweep up/down, rain, scatter, dissolve and a brightness-driven 'bloom' where the brightest splats ignite first with a flare and twinkle; each splat grows from a dot with per-splat jitter, entrance motion (fall/scatter/rise), a settle hop, glow, and a one-shot scale bump at the end. Driven on the GPU from uProgress/uTime, disables itself when a non-looping reveal completes, and restores the original chunk on unload.

entries.title: Splat Crop
entries.summary: A movable, rotatable oriented crop box for the space's already-loaded Gaussian splat(s). The vibe's own entity IS the box: set dimensions with Box Size and keep only splats inside it (or carve a hole with Invert), with a soft edge fade. Applies to the unified splat material and every non-unified gsplat material at once via a gsplatModifyVS shader chunk (GLSL + WGSL, WebGL + WebGPU). The Crop Splats toggle (default on) can be turned off to use the box purely as a selector, and Cull Google Tiles publishes the same box to a Google 3D Tiles vibe so it carves a matching hole.

entries.title: Splat Portal
entries.summary: Reveals ANOTHER scene splat only through a rectangular opening, via a stencil mask on the shared 'Splats' layer. The target can be a splat that is HIDDEN (disabled) in the scene — enableTargetSplat (default on) force-enables it so it appears ONLY through the window, then restores it on unload. Options: near-clip (hide splats in front), horizontal screen curve, additive glossy env reflection, and a solid-screen mode that hides everything behind while objects in front still occlude it. Picks the target with an entity picker (filterTypes:['splat']). See the file for the rendering details.

entries.title: Splat Monitor
entries.summary: A flat screen showing a LIVE render-to-texture feed of the space (or one isolated splat) from a second hidden camera — a monitor / CCTV panel. POV sources: a camera entity (with flip + forward offset), follow the player camera, or a fixed world viewpoint; windowMode turns it into an off-axis-projection portal window with optional per-fragment curve compensation. Feed FX: resolution, pixelated, tint/gain, scanlines, LED pixel raster; plus on-demand rendering (freeze when static), clip-in-front of feed splats, screen curve, collision box, and a glowing frame. Its pc.RenderTarget can be recorded to video by the Feed Recorder plugin.

entries.title: Feed Recorder
entries.summary: Records a Splat Monitor's render-target feed to a downloadable video file (WebM via MediaRecorder). Async GPU texture readback into a canvas at a configurable capture FPS and bitrate, with a fallback HUD record/stop button + PNG snapshot, a toggle hotkey, max-duration auto-stop, and local event-bus control (recorder:start/stop/toggle/snapshot fired by other plugins; fires recorder:started/stopped/saved back; recorder:query answered with recorder:state). Controller plugins with their own record UI (e.g. rail-camera) claim/hide the fallback HUD via recorder:ui:claim/release. Shows a 'CLIP SAVED' toast on download. Auto-discovers the first Splat Monitor or records any picked plugin entity exposing a pc.RenderTarget (_rt/_texture); auto-corrects flipPov feeds. Keeps an on-demand monitor rendering while recording.

entries.title: Rail Camera
entries.summary: Click a box (or use a 2D camera-operator panel) to enter a constrained free-fly studio camera that slides only along enabled local axes with per-axis travel limits — a virtual dolly/rail rig. Cine viewfinder HUD with corner brackets, crosshair, letterbox aspect, joystick + pan/tilt sliders, zoom rocker with mm readout, EV exposure meter with HDR Neutral toggle, and an ARRI-style record status strip (blinking tally, SMPTE timecode, snapshot button) driving the Feed Recorder over the event bus (recorder:toggle/query, claims the recorder HUD). Operator panel has a morphing round shutter button + stills button + timecode. Can pin a follow entity to the camera (pair with a Splat Monitor's Camera-POV for a live filming rig), slide a dolly/tripod model along the floor, and sync zoom to linked monitors.
